description: Turn a face photo into a lip-synced talking-head video that speaks your text (or your audio). Provide image_url (a clear face photo) and either script (text to speak, max 2500 characters) or audio_url. Optional voice_id / language / voice_settings. Renders in ~1-5 minutes (single call, returns the finished branded video) and is saved to your library. Charged per video.

audio_url.description: Pre-recorded audio URL to lip-sync instead of generating speech from script.

image_url.description: A clear face photo (Switch/public URL). Required.

script.description: Text the avatar speaks. Max 2500 characters. Required unless audio_url is given.

voice_id.description: Optional voice id (from clone_voice / your library).

name: talking_avatar_video
title: Talking Avatar Video
